body: THE RECEIPTS CLAUSE — it rides at the front of this book because it is the deal, in plain words:

Finish the Starter Manual and THE MIRROR — 28 DAYS OF PROOF — back to back, 56 days, fully documented (a journal entry every day, workouts on video with your face in them, Mirror Sheets filled in and photographed), submit, RODA audits; if they hold up, half the Starter price comes back by PayPal — $9.50.

The money is earned by finishing alone. Public use of your story is a separate permission, asked separately, declinable with every cent kept. Proving Season purchases only, one payout per person, the audit's word is final.
This app is where the documentation lives. Every check-in you make here is a dated receipt. Stack 56 of them and the file builds itself.
